name: print-social-tokyo-travel-collage-with-stacked-vertical-title
title: Tokyo travel post with giant stacked letters, sakura branches and a girl by a vending machine
whatItIs: A white portrait collage where TOKYO is spelled vertically in huge letters filled with street photos, with a sakura branch, a cat mascot sticker, a receipt and a bottle cutout at left and a girl in white by a vending machine at right, plus 'for a week' in tiny text.
whatItMeans: Vibrant and travel-diary-like; photos inside letters make a place spell itself.
techniques: Fill giant letters with photos of the place.

vocabulary.definition: A word arranged top to bottom.
Small objects hinting at a trip.
A layered set of trip images.
